version.description: Schema version for this metrics artifact

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when metrics were collected

queue_depth.description: Number of tasks waiting in the task queue

agent_utilization.description: Ratio of active agents to total agent pool (0.0 to 1.0)

supervisor_latency_ms.description: P95 latency (ms) for supervisor to assign tasks from queue

task_throughput_per_minute.description: Tasks completed per minute in current topology

coordination_overhead_ratio.description: Coordination messages per completed task (lower is better)

collection_window_seconds.description: Duration (seconds) over which this metric sample was collected
